description:
Experience Premium Living at Broadside Manchester
Welcome to Broadside, a modern residential community in Manchester's dynamic New Cross district. Offering stunning one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, Broadside blends sleek, contemporary design with outstanding convenience.

Stylish Interiors for Modern Lifestyles
Each apartment features high-quality finishes, spacious open-plan layouts, and energy-efficient appliances, perfectly balancing comfort and style. Floor-to-ceiling windows fill your home with natural light, while premium kitchens and bathrooms provide a luxurious touch.

Amenities That Redefine Living
Broadside’s exclusive amenities cater to work, wellness, and leisure:
- Rooftop Terraces with breathtaking city views.
- Fitness Studio with exercise bikes and yoga matts.
- Co-Working Spaces ideal for productivity.
- 24/7 Concierge Service for ultimate convenience.
- Pet-Friendly Living with a welcoming community.

Stay connected with super-fast Wi-Fi, secure parking for an additional cost, and resident events fostering a vibrant neighbourhood atmosphere.

Prime Location Near Manchester’s Best
Enjoy the Northern Quarter's eclectic shops, bars, and dining just moments away. Broadside offers urban living at its finest, with everything you need at your doorstep.

Discover your perfect city home at Broadside.

*Available for student let
Viewing Tour disclaimer: This advertisement relates to a specific unit at the stated rent. Where multiple units are available within the same development, you may be shown other apartments during your viewing. Each unit is marketed at its own advertised rent, which will be clearly confirmed to you before any offer is submitted. We do not accept offers above the advertised rent for any property. The rent agreed will always be the advertised rent for the selected unit, in accordance with the Renters’ Rights Act.
